ValidationRule.description: ALF-LM-07: a Disqualified Lead cannot be edited except to reactivate it (change Status away from Disqualified via the Reactivate Lead Quick Action). Blocks any save that leaves it still Disqualified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Disqualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Disqualified"), OR( ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(Phone), ISCHANGED(Email), ISCHANGED(Company), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(AF_Brand__c), ISCHANGED(AF_VehicleOfInterest__c), ISCHANGED(Rating), ISCHANGED(AF_ContactValidity__c), ISCHANGED(AF_SourceOfBusiness__c), ISCHANGED(AF_QualificationOutcome__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Lead is Disqualified and cannot be edited. Use the Reactivate Lead action first.
